title: Separate Circle platform metrics, Coinbase distribution economics and Coinbase collateral hierarchies

decisions.rule: Label Circle's 19.5% Q2 2026 metric as Circle-owned platform share; never alias it to Coinbase share.
Keep average USDC held in Coinbase products separate from Coinbase Assets on Platform and point-in-time custody balances.
Circle Mint customer fiat conversions are not total market supply changes, secondary-market flows, or XRP settlement flows.
Circle distribution costs paid in connection with Coinbase agreements are not Coinbase USDC balances or XRP capital flows. Preserve issuer-retention and ecosystem-growth components separately.
Do not add nested or differently recognized collateral pools. Keep the separate encumbrance view and unrecognized customer collateral distinct.
Admit only explicitly named asset-level collateral. Aggregate 'other crypto' and unitemized customer collateral cannot be attributed to XRP.

data_quality_rules: Use Circle Q2 (2026-06-30) and Coinbase Q3 (2026-09-30) as separate point-in-time periods; do not merge as synchronized observations.
Circle's Q2 mint/redeem metric covers Circle Mint customer conversions only.

Coinbase's Q3 SEC filing reports stablecoin revenue USD306.905M versus USD324.534M in Q3 2025; preserve the filing's Q1 2026 presentation change that moved corporate payment-stablecoin balance interest to Other revenue.
Coinbase Q3 derivatives collateral table names BTC and ETH; no XRP-specific amount is disclosed. Do not infer zero XRP exposure in unitemized customer collateral.
Do not use Circle Q2 19.5% platform share as Coinbase platform share.
Do not infer XRP demand from USDC minting, redemption, Coinbase distribution payments or Circle Arc validator participation without route-level XRP conversion/settlement evidence.
feature_admission: NONE; all observations context-only until synchronized, point-in-time and leakage-safe historical series are built.
